topics.main: Listening and speaking
topics.text: Develop listening and speaking skills in different contexts

items.text: (a) Imitate different sounds (e.g.sounds of animals, hands clap etc.)
(b) Relate words with familiar objects found in the environment (e.g. home, school, market, hospital, playgrounds)
(c) Follow the simple instructions given at school and home (e.g. go out, stand up, jump, clap your hands, touch your head and sit down)
(d) Introduce oneself and others
(e) Name parts of the body orally
(f) Use common greetings and say goodbye to others

topics.main: Reading
topics.text: Recognise letter sounds

items.text: (a) Pronounce letter sounds a-z
(b) Identify individual sounds in simple words (initial, middle, and last sounds)
(c) Identify words with the same last sound (rhyming) and words with the same first sound (alliteration)
(d) Blend individual sounds to form simple words
(e) Pronounce words with short vowel sounds (e.g. bat, mat, red, hit, hot, cup)

topics.main: Reading
topics.text: Recognise letter-sound relationships

items.text: (a) Associate letters with sounds
(b) Read single syllable words with simple structure (vowel consonant-at, consonant-vowel-consonant -cat)
(c) Read words with two consonant clusters (e.g. bl, cl, fl, gl, pl, sl, br, cr, dr, fr, gr, pr, tr, sc, sk, sm, sn, sp, st, sw, and tw)
(d) Read words with consonant digraphs (e.g. th, ch, sh, ph)
(e) Read words with vowel digraphs (Target: ai, ay, ee, ea, oa and oe)

topics.main: Reading
